rankCompressionMetrics: saturatedRows and saturationRate by scanDate on clean complete parent
flattenedDistinctPreClampPairs: pairs with different preClamp flattened to score=100
unique institutionalScore count / tied score groups / max tie size
semanticGuards: sameSessionDirectionPoints measures repeated use of same-session direction information, not proof that nonlinear interactions are harmful.
persistenceBeyondDay1 isolates only the additional streak days beyond the current session.
chipConcentration is ownership concentration, not institutional identity.
rank compression is claimed only for the institutional component; overall Formal ranking can still differ through other PriorityScore and lexicographic inputs.
complete clean same-scan parent is mandatory; selected-only FULL_FORMAL_SCAN persistence and bounded Shadow cannot support full-scan prevalence.

smallCapThresholdGuard.semantics: For marketCap 10-30bn, institutionalScore>=70 participates in the special-reason gate together with 1.5x liquidity. Score compression above 100 cannot change whether 70 is passed.
smallCapThresholdGuard.implication: Measure >=70 occupancy separately from saturation. Do not claim score-cap compression is itself a small-cap-admission defect.
